questions.text: Which memory loses its contents when power is turned off?
questions.explanation: RAM is volatile memory and requires power to retain data.

questions.text: Which component executes program instructions?
questions.explanation: The CPU fetches, decodes and executes instructions.

questions.text: How many bits make one byte?
questions.explanation: One byte consists of eight bits.

questions.text: Which device is used for persistent storage?
questions.explanation: An SSD retains stored data without power.

questions.text: What is the decimal value of binary 1010?
Which device is an input device?
questions.explanation: A keyboard sends user input to the computer.

questions.text: Which data structure follows FIFO?
questions.explanation: A queue removes the first item inserted: first in, first out.

questions.text: Which data structure follows LIFO?
questions.explanation: A stack removes the last item inserted first.

questions.text: What does binary search require?
questions.explanation: Binary search eliminates half of a sorted search range at each step.

questions.text: What is the worst-case time complexity of linear search?
questions.explanation: Linear search may inspect all n items.

questions.text: What is a function calling itself called?
questions.explanation: Recursion solves a problem by calling the same function on a smaller case.

questions.text: Which traversal uses a queue?
questions.explanation: Breadth-first search uses a queue to process nodes level by level.

questions.text: Which SQL statement reads rows?
questions.explanation: SELECT retrieves rows from a table.

questions.text: What uniquely identifies a row?
questions.explanation: A primary key uniquely identifies each row and cannot be null.

questions.text: Which clause filters rows before grouping?
questions.explanation: WHERE filters input rows before GROUP BY aggregation.

questions.text: What does a foreign key enforce?
questions.explanation: A foreign key links a row to an existing referenced record.

questions.text: Which SQL aggregate counts rows with COUNT(*)?
questions.explanation: COUNT(*) returns the number of rows in the selected group.

questions.text: Which operation undoes an uncommitted transaction?
questions.explanation: ROLLBACK cancels changes made in the current uncommitted transaction.

questions.text: What does DNS resolve?
questions.explanation: DNS resolves domain names to IP addresses.

questions.text: Which protocol provides reliable ordered transport?
questions.explanation: TCP provides ordered delivery with retransmission for missing data.

questions.text: What protects HTTPS traffic in transit?
questions.explanation: HTTPS uses TLS to protect traffic in transit.

questions.text: Which IPv4 address is a loopback address?
questions.explanation: 127.0.0.1 refers to the local host through the loopback interface.

questions.text: Which device forwards packets between networks?
questions.explanation: A router forwards IP packets between networks.

questions.text: Which practice adds a second authentication factor?
questions.explanation: An authenticator code provides a possession factor in addition to a password.
